byExperience.label: other games; no text adventures named

findings: Across the 44 full runs (rounds 7 to 17), the round a run belonged to accounts for 99% of the run-to-run spread in negative rows per 100 commands, and typed against click for 3%. For best score the shares are 54% and 8%.

The cleanest comparison is the 19 runs played wholly in Claude Code with UNDO off (rounds 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 14 and 15a): one host, one protocol, a different persona in every run. Their negative rows per 100 commands ran only from 0.4 to 2.1; round means 0.5 to 1.9.

Within them, by mode: typed 1.3 (7 runs), click 1.5 (12 runs). By what the persona says of experience: has played text adventures 1.6 (3 runs), new to text adventures 1.6 (3 runs), other games; no text adventures named 1.4 (13 runs). By pace: careful, reads everything 1.7 (6 runs), fast, skims 1.4 (6 runs), pace not stated 1.4 (7 runs). Mode accounts for 7% of that spread, experience for 6% and pace for 12%, each from groups of two to ten runs.

Best score, in the same runs: by experience has played text adventures 60.3, new to text adventures 52.3, other games; no text adventures named 56.0; by pace careful, reads everything 56.3, fast, skims 56.7, pace not stated 55.4. Score and friction rate correlate at r = 0.49.

By the host each leg ran in (decisions/work.jsonl): Claude Code, 69 legs and 25,862 commands, 1.6 negative rows per 100 (2.8 all rows); host not recorded, 3 legs and 1,102 commands, 1.8 negative rows per 100 (2.4 all rows); Copilot (Claude Opus 5.5), 3 legs and 1,200 commands, 2.3 negative rows per 100 (4.7 all rows); Copilot (Claude Opus 5.5, then GPT-6 Luna), 12 legs and 3,070 commands, 11.0 negative rows per 100 (22.0 all rows); Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5), 2 legs and 237 commands, 3.0 negative rows per 100 (6.3 all rows); Claude Code (claude-opus-5-5), 9 legs and 3,000 commands, 1.5 negative rows per 100 (2.6 all rows); Claude Code (claude-sonnet-5-5), 10 legs and 2,945 commands, 0.5 negative rows per 100 (0.6 all rows); host not recorded (claude-sonnet-5-5), 36 legs and 10,322 commands, 0.4 negative rows per 100 (0.5 all rows); host not recorded (claude-opus-5-5), 35 legs and 13,158 commands, 1.0 negative rows per 100 (1.7 all rows); host not recorded (gpt-6-astra), 11 legs and 4,109 commands, 1.3 negative rows per 100 (2.1 all rows).
